option.helptext:
When enabled, all floating combat damage per entity will be condensed into a single summed value.
Can reduce visual clutter when you or your enemies are hitting multiple times per turn.

option.DisplayText: Randomize direction of floating combat text
option.helptext:
Adds random deviation to the direction of the floating combat text.
Especially useful if 'Condense floating combat text' is disabled to avoid overlapping text.

Limits the amount of melee animations performed per turn.
Can reduce visual clutter when you or your enemies are hitting multiple times per turn.
